duplicates.title: Duplicates report
duplicates.desc: Shows who appears repeated across grid teachers, badges and access requests. Separates the same person with several records (suggests merging), different people sharing a phone (warning) and equal names with nothing else in common (info only). Read-only. Reads badges and requests once (a few hundred reads).
duplicates.error: Could not read badges and requests (quota exhausted or offline). Try again later.
duplicates.readSummary: {{teachers}} schedule teachers (already loaded, no reads) + {{reads}} badges and requests read now.

types.soNome: Only the name matches (maybe a namesake)

duplicates.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, e-mail or phone (applies to all lists)
duplicates.noMatch: No one in this list matches the search.

help.semTrava: The same e-mail or phone on different people: the system cannot lock it. If it is the same person, use "Merge" or "Link". If they are different people, use "Fix" on whoever has the wrong data (or clear the phone).
help.mesma: The same person with more than one record, or with record and badge not linked. Use "Merge" or "Link".
help.outra: Same phone, very different names: probably a typo or family. Use "Fix" on whoever has the wrong phone.
help.soNome: Only the name matches, nothing else in common: usually namesakes. Check; if it is the same person, use "Merge".
help.telefoneInvalido: Phone that is not a valid number: use "Fix".
help.emailDeMentira: Made-up e-mail (e.g. none@...): use "Fix" with the real e-mail.
help.loginAntigo: Old logins (password 123456 and unit login): already out of the count, nothing to do.

merge.title: Merge schedule records
merge.desc: Check the records that are the SAME person and choose the one to keep. Classes, units, validations and payments of the others move to it, and the other records are deleted.
merge.sumSummaries: Monthly closing rebuilt next time reports open: {{list}}
merge.sumFill: Missing data that will be filled in: {{list}}
merge.sumDocument: The ID (CPF/DNI/SSN) moves to the record that stays
merge.documentConflict: These records have DIFFERENT IDs: they are different people and cannot be merged.
merge.cost: Reads done now: {{reads}} · writes when merging: {{writes}}
merge.done: Done! The records were merged into {{name}}'s.
merge.readError: Could not check (quota exhausted or offline). Try again later.
merge.writeError: The merge stopped halfway (quota or connection). Nothing is lost: check and merge again to finish.

link.title: Link record to badge
link.desc: The same person has a schedule record and an access badge (e.g. a leader who teaches), but they are not linked. Pick the record and the badge. Nothing is deleted.
link.badgeHasOther: This badge is already linked to another schedule record. Merge the records first (Merge records button), then link.
link.recordHasOther: This record is linked to another login (probably the old one). Linking makes it use this badge.
link.done: Done! {{name}}'s record is linked to the badge.
link.error: Could not link (quota exhausted or offline). Try again.
link.documentConflict: The record and the badge have DIFFERENT IDs: they are different people. Not linked.
link.copiedDocument: The login's ID was copied to the record.
link.whatHappens: When linking: the record starts using this login (the old login, if any, no longer applies to it), the badge points to the record and the login's ID goes to the record. Classes, units, validations and name stay as they are.
link.leaderEffect: This badge belongs to a leader/mentor. Once linked, the person becomes a 'leader who also teaches': if they ever leave the leadership, they keep teacher access. Link only if they teach (or taught) with this record.

dupBadge.otherHint: Please check: could be a typo or family. They are not the same person.

fix.title: Fix e-mail / phone
fix.done: Fixed. The list is already updated.
fix.loginEmail: This is the Google login e-mail: it does not change here.
fix.phoneHint: Leave blank to clear the phone (e.g. the admin account of the same person).
fix.phoneInvalid: Invalid phone (check the area code and digits).
fix.taken: Not saved: this data already belongs to {{who}}.
